designOnly.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: final visual target for a 480x270 mobile landscape Phaser sheep-running game's game-over score screen, rendered at 1920x1080 with a 16:9 aspect ratio.
Input image 1 is a STYLE reference for chunky warm pixel-art wooden UI, cream panels, leaves, white daisies, and a small cute sheep. It is NOT a target to reproduce as a pause screen. Input image 2 is the pastoral BACKGROUND reference.
Primary request: design a polished end-of-run score screen with the same visual language as those references. A single broad central cream score panel bordered by thick warm orange/brown wood, leafy corner decorations and white daisies. A blank-eyed cheerful little white sheep peeks over a curved wooden title board at top. The current score is the strongest item in the composition. Keep the scene cheerful and calm, no injury or defeat effects.
Exact composition in logical coordinates (multiply all coordinates by four for the output):
- Panel roughly x=66,y=32,width=348,height=210.
- A wooden heading at x=150,y=22,width=180,height=42 says exactly "本次得分".
- Huge golden orange pixel score "12345" centered x=240,y=98, readable and prominent.
- Small gold crown with the phrase "新的牧场纪录！" centered beneath score around y=132.
- A narrower cream inset row around y=158 says "牧场纪录  12345".
- Two balanced coin-information sections around y=184, a gold coin beside "金币 +25" on the left and "余额 128" on the right.
- At the bottom two independent framed buttons in one row: large golden primary button centered x=171,y=218,width=160,height=36, circular retry arrow on the left and "再跑一次"; warm cream secondary button centered x=335,y=218,width=132,height=36, small house icon on the left and "返回牧场".
Keep every object and both buttons inside the screen with generous separation. Do not add any other actions, stars count, stores, tasks, upgrades, ads, close icons or unrelated widgets.
Typography: clear chunky dark-brown pixel Chinese lettering for labels and buttons; score has warm gold fill with stepped dark-brown outline and subtle pixel shadow. Correct Chinese strings verbatim. Every text has adequate padding and does not touch art borders or icons.
Backdrop: preserve the landscape of input image 2, full-bleed across all edges. Slight dark warm translucent dimming behind the panel, no outside margins, no device frame. No HTML border. Keep the panel lively bright.
Style: crisp hard-edged 16-bit game pixel art, nearest-neighbor look, small squared wood grain accents, warm cream/yellow highlights. No blur, photorealism, smooth vector curves, floating soft shadows, glossy mobile app style, watermark, grid, annotations or extraneous text.
This image is a design target only; its numbers are example data. The implementation will render live text with the local pixel font and split the decorative artwork into reusable assets.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit this existing sheep-run game-over UI design with exactly one layout change.
Preserve the pastoral pixel-art style, dimmed farm background, the whole central wooden/cream panel, sheep mascot, title, giant gold score, new-record badge, record row and both bottom buttons at their exact existing positions and proportions. Keep all remaining text and numbers as drawn.
Replace the TWO small currency boxes ("金币 +25" and "余额 128") with ONE centered horizontal cream-and-gold inset box occupying their combined existing row. It should contain a single golden coin icon followed by the exact text "金币 +25", centered as one group. No balance label and no balance number. Do not display stars, star count, star balance, or any other currency information.
The final design should have only these values: current score 12345, best score 12345, coins earned +25. Buttons still read "再跑一次" and "返回牧场".
Keep the crisp hard-edged pixel grid, all wood grain, flowers, leaves, and unchanged bright panel colors. No additional text or controls. Keep the same image dimensions and exact composition.

runtime.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent runtime decorative panel for a Phaser pixel-art game.
Input image 1 is the edit target. Preserve its exact panel silhouette, wood frame, title plank, peeking cream sheep, leaves, daisies, cream inner fill, stepped pixel edges, colors, highlights, and arrangement. Keep the same 1672 x 941 canvas and exact original positions; do not resize or recompose the panel.
Remove the entire landscape behind the panel and make all pixels outside its decorative silhouette genuinely transparent.
Inside the panel remove ALL text and digits, including the title, large score, record wording, best-score row, coin wording and both button labels. Leave blank wood at the title and blank cream wherever score/text were.
Remove the ENTIRE crown/new-record badge including its golden pill and orange rays; restore flat cream beneath it.
Remove BOTH bottom buttons including frames, icons, lettering and shadows, restoring the cream panel underneath. Buttons will be separate runtime assets.
Preserve the existing inset horizontal best-score row frame and the single wide centered coins-earned row frame, but remove all text and the coin icon from their interiors. Preserve the two leaf decorations beside the large score.
No replacement text, letters, digits, balance, stars, watermarks, checkerboard, opaque background, or new decoration. Only the original blank decorative panel remains, on true alpha transparency. Crisp nearest-neighbor pixel-art edges, no blur.
runtime.use: Blank transparent panel; no text, numbers, record badge or buttons
